names.structure: Verb spine (Analyze · Research · Review · Deliver) — one chapter per verb
names.pacing: Measured — new beat every 1.5–2 s, in-camera scene changes
names.camera: Locked frame — motion lives in type and elements
transitions: Background wash changes colour/family between chapters
Tilt away / tilt in of planes
names.colour: Lavender / mint / cream washes per chapter + one violet accent
names.ui_treatment: No UI — product, place and people only (non-software businesses)
names.motion_feel: Soft, high damping, long ease-in-out — nothing snaps
names.sound: Light pulse ~120–130 bpm, clicky UI ticks, no big hits

names.structure: A day in the life — morning problem → midday turn → evening calm
names.pacing: Cinematic — new beat every 2–3 s, 0–2 hard cuts
names.camera: Tilted 3D planes (15–25° Y), push to prompt, pull back to grids
transitions: Tilt away / tilt in of planes
names.typography: Editorial serif headlines, wide tracking caps labels
names.colour: Golden hour → dusk: rose, sand, coral, rust, dusk blue
names.ui_treatment: Frosted glass panels, inner highlight, 1 px light edge
names.motion_feel: Soft, high damping, long ease-in-out — nothing snaps
names.sound: Warm cinematic bed, light percussion, very few SFX

names.structure: Craft reveal — raw material → process → finished product → people enjoying it

names.camera: Vertical travel — falls, drops and rises following one object
transitions: Line draws and branches; camera follows the tip
